recordings.label: Orukeet preview, final, history and OS clipboard

scope: Actual production Electron renderer, preload, main process, FFmpeg, sherpa-onnx and SQLite. Existing isolated profile from the public GUI installation. WAV supplies MediaRecorder microphone input; the OS file chooser selects controlled fixtures. No recognition, persistence or clipboard result is mocked. Native global-hotkey and paste injection are separate from this test. Guest account and clipboard/preview preferences are test fixtures. The separate restart phase does not reseed preferences.
